book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ LUKU U YORUA

content: Kɑnɑrun ɡɑri
Sɔ̃ɔ teeru Yesu u kɑnɑru mɔ̀ ɡɑm ɡum. Sɑɑ ye u kpɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbun turo u nɛɛ, Yinni kpɑ ɑ sun sɔ̃ɔsi mɛ bɑ rɑ kɑnɑru ko, nɡe mɛ Yohɑnu u win bwɑ̃ɑbu sɔ̃ɔsi.
Yesu u bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ bɑ̀ n kɑnɑru mɔ̀ bɑ n dɑ nɛɛ,

content.text: Bɑɑbɑ, ɑ de bɑ n yɛ̃ mɑ wunɑ sɑ̃ɑ Dɛɛro.
A sun bɛsɛn dĩɑnu kɛ̃ tɔ̃ru bɑɑtere.
A sun bɛsɛn torɑnu suuru kuo
domi bɛsɛn tii sɑ rɑ wi u sun torɑri suuru kue.
A ku kɑ sun dɑ kɔkiribun berɑ ɡiɑ.

content: U kpɑm bu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, nɡe mɛ n tɛ̃ wɑ̃ɑ, bɛɛn turo u n bɔrɔ mɔ, kpɑ u dɑ win mi wɔ̃ku suunu sɔɔ u nɛɛ u nùn pɛ̃ɛ itɑ bɔkuro,
domi win kpɑɑsibun turowɑ ɡɑm wee, wi kun mɑɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu mɔ u nùn wɛ̃.
Sɑɑ sɔɔn di kpɑ bɔrɔ wi, u nɛɛ, u ku nùn bɑɑsi, u kɔnnɔ kɛnuɑ kɔ, wi kɑ win bibu bɑ kpĩ. U ǹ mɑɑ kpɛ̃ u se u sere nùn pɛ̃ɛ wɛ̃.
Yesu u nɛɛ, nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, bɑɑ ù kun seewe u nùn wɛ̃ bɔrɔnun sɔ̃, u koo se u nùn wɛ̃ yèn bukɑtɑ u mɔ kpuro win bɑɑsibun sɔ̃.
Nɑ mɑɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, i n dɑ bikie, bɑ koo bɛɛ wɛ̃. I n dɑ kɑsu, i ko wɑ. I n dɑ ɡɑmbo so, bɑ koo bɛɛ kɛniɑ.
Domi bɑɑwure wi u bikiɑmɔ bɑ koo nùn wɛ̃. Wi u kɑsu u koo wɑ. Wi u mɑɑ ɡɑmbo soomɔ, bɑ koo yɛ̃ro kɛniɑ.
Bɛɛ sɔɔ, [ɡoon bii ù n nùn pɛ̃ɛ bikiɑ, u koo wurɑ u nùn kperu wɛ̃?] Ǹ kun mɛ ù n swɑ̃ɑ bikiɑ, u koo nùn wɑɑ wɛ̃?
Ǹ kun mɛ ù n sɛ̃ɛru bikiɑ, u koo nùn niɑ wɛ̃?
Bɛɛ be i sɑ̃ɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobu, mɑ i yɛ̃ nɡe mɛ bɑ rɑ bibu kɛ̃ɛ ɡeenu wɛ̃, bɛɛn Bɑɑbɑ wɔlluɡii u ǹ koo be bɑ nùn kɑnɑmɔ Hunde Dɛɛro wɛ̃?
Yesu kɑ tii yinɑmɔ
Yesu u wɛrɛku ɡirɑ ɡe ɡɑ tɔnu ɡoo soso kuɑ. Sɑnɑm mɛ wɛrɛku ɡe, ɡɑ doonɑ, soso wi, u ɡɑri ɡerubu wɔri, mɑ tɔn wɔru ɡɑ biti soorɑ.
Adɑmɑ ɡɑbɑ nɛɛ, wɛrɛkunun sunɔ Beseburu, win dɑmɑ u kɑ wɛrɛkunu ɡirɑmɔ.
Gɑbɑ kĩ bu win lɑɑkɑri mɛɛri, mɑ bɑ nùn bikiɑ u sɔm mɑɑmɑɑkiɡiru ko u kɑ sɔ̃ɔsi mɑ win yiiko yɑ weewɑ wɔllun di.
Yesu u ben bwisikunu yɛ̃, yerɑ u nɛɛ, bɑndu bɑɑtere tèn tɔmbu bɑ tɑbu mɔ̀ ben tii tiinɛ sɔɔ, bɑn te, tɑ koo kowɑ bɑnsu kpɑ ten yɛnusu su wɔruku.
Mɛyɑ mɑɑ Setɑm yɑ̀ n kɑ yen tii tɑbu mɔ̀, ɑmɔnɑ yen bɑndɑ koo kɑ yɔ̃rɑ. Domi i nɛɛ, Beseburun dɑmɑ nɑ kɑ wɛrɛkunu ɡirɑmɔ.
Nɛ, nɑ̀ n wɛrɛkunu ɡirɑmɔ kɑ Beseburun dɑm, wɑrɑn dɑmɑ bɛɛn bwɑ̃ɑbu bɑ kɑ ni ɡirɑmɔ. Ben tiiwɑ bɑ koo sɔ̃ɔsi mɑ i torɑ.
Adɑmɑ ǹ n kɑ Gusunɔn dɑm nɑ, nɑ wɛrɛkunu ɡirɑmɔ, kɑ ɡem bɑn te Gusunɔ u swĩi, tɑ bɛɛ nɑɑwɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ durɔ dɑmɡii wi u tɑbu yɑ̃nu mɔ u win yɛnu kɔ̃su win dukiɑ ko n wɑ̃ɑwɑ ɑlɑfiɑ sɔɔ.
Adɑmɑ ɡoo wi u nùn dɑm kere, ù n nɑ u nùn wɔri u kɑmiɑ, u koo win tɑbu yɑ̃nu kpuro ɡurɑ ni u nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑ kpɑ u win dukiɑ ɡɑbu bɔnu kuɑ.
Wi u kun sɑ̃ɑ nɛɡii u kɑ mɑn yibɛrɛ tɛɛru nɛniwɑ, wi u ku rɑ mɑɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu mɛnnɛ kɑ nɛ sɑnnu, u rɑ ni yɑrinɑsiewɑ.
Wɛrɛkunun wurɑmɑru
Yesu mɑɑ nɛɛ, wɛrɛkunu nù n doonɑ tɔnun min di, nu rɑ n bɔsuwɑ mi ɡɑ̃ɑnu ku rɑ kpi nu n wɛ̃rɑ yeru kɑsu nu n bie. Yerɑ nu rɑ nɛɛ, nu koo ɡɔsirɑ nin wɑ̃ɑ yerɔ mìn di nu rɑɑ doonɑ.
Nu rɑ wurɑmɛ kpɑ nu deemɑ tɑ kurɑre tɑ sɔnde.
Kpɑ nu dɑ nu ɡɑnu nɔɔbɑ yiru kɑsumɑ ni nu ni kɔ̃suru kere, kpɑ nu du yɛ̃ro sɔɔ nu n wɑ̃ɑ mi. Sɑɑ ye, yɛ̃ro win wɑ̃ɑ ɡbiikiru tɑ koo sɑ̃ɑyɑ kɑ sere dɑ̃ɑkiru.
Nuku doo ɡeebu
Sɑnɑm mɛ Yesu u ɡɑri ɡerumɔ mɛsum, tɔn wɔrun suunu sɔɔn di kurɔ ɡoo u nɔɔɡiru suɑ u nɛɛ, doo nɔɔruɡiiwɑ wi u wunɛn ɡurɑ suɑ, mɑ ɑ win bwɑ̃ɑ nɔrɑ.
Mɑ Yesu u nɛɛ, n sɑnɔ ɑ ɡere, doo nɔɔruɡibɑ be bɑ Gusunɔn ɡɑri swɑɑ dɑkimɔ, mɑ bɑ yi nɛnumɔ.
Tɔmbɑ yĩreru bikiɑ
Sɑnɑm mɛ tɔn wɔru ɡɑ mɛnnɑmɔ yerɑ Yesu u nɛɛ, tɛ̃n tɔmbu tɔn kɔ̃sobɑ. Bɑ yĩreru bikiɑmɔ ɑdɑmɑ yĩreru ɡɑru mɑɑ sɑri te bɑ koo bu sɔ̃ɔsi mɑ n kun mɔ Gusunɔn sɔmɔ Yonɑsiɡiru.
Domi nɡe mɛ Yonɑsi u kuɑ yĩreru Ninifuɡibun sɔ̃, mɛyɑ mɑɑ Tɔnun Bii, u koo ko yĩreru tɛ̃n tɔmbun sɔ̃.
Siribun sɑnɑm sɔɔ Sebɑn tem tɔn kurɔ sunɔ u koo tɛ̃n tɔmbu seesi u bu tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃, yèn sɔ̃ u nɑ sɑɑ tem nɔrun di u kɑ Sɑlomɔɔn bwisin ɡɑri nɔ. Tɛ̃ n wee, ɡɑ̃ɑnu wɑ̃ɑ mini ni nu Sɑlomɔɔ kere.
Siribun sɑnɑm sɔɔ Ninifuɡibu bɑ koo tɛ̃n tɔmbu seesi bu bu tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃ ye bɑ kɑ ɡɔ̃ru ɡɔsiɑ Yonɑsin wɑɑsun sɔ̃. Mɑ tɛ̃ n wee, ɡɑ̃ɑnu wɑ̃ɑ mini ni nu Yonɑsi kere.
Wɑsin fitilɑ
Yesu mɑɑ nɛɛ, ɡoo ku rɑ fitilɑ mɛni kpɑ u ɡu bere, ǹ kun mɛ u kɑɑru wukiri, ɑdɑmɑ bɑ rɑ ɡu sɔndiwɑ dɑbu wɔllɔ, kpɑ be bɑ dumɔ bɑ n kɑ yɑm bururɑm wɑɑmɔ.
Wunɛn nɔniyɑ yi wunɛn wɑsin fitilɑ. Wunɛn nɔni yì n ɑlɑfiɑ mɔ, wunɛn wɑsi kpurowɑ yi yɑm bururɑm mɔ. Adɑmɑ yì kun bwɑ̃ɑ do, wunɛn wɑsi yi ǹ yɑm bururɑm wɑsi.
Yen sɔ̃, ɑ lɑɑkɑri koowo yɑm bururɑm mɛ mu wɑ̃ɑ wunɛ sɔɔ mu ku rɑɑ ko yɑm wɔ̃kuru.
Wunɛn wɑsi kpuro yì n yɑm dɛɛrɑm mɔ, mɑ yin ɡɑm kun wɑ̃ɑ yɑm wɔ̃kuru sɔɔ, yi kpurowɑ yi ko n dɛɛre nɡe sɑnɑm mɛ fitilɑ ɡɑ nun yɑm bururɑsie ɡɑ bɑllimɔ.
Yesu u Fɑlisibɑ kɑ woodɑ yɛ̃robu
ben torɑnu sɔ̃ɔwɑ
Sɑnɑm mɛ Yesu u ɡɑri ɡeruɑ u kpɑ, Fɑlisi ɡoo nɑ u nùn kɑnɑ u dɑ u yɑɑ dibu di win yɛnuɔ. Mɑ u dɑ mi, u sinɑ u kɑ di.
Fɑlisi wi, u nùn mɛɛrɑ kɑ biti ye u ǹ kɑ niɛ nɡe mɛ ben komɑru u sere di.
Adɑmɑ Yinni u nɛɛ, bɛɛ Fɑlisibɑ i rɑ nɔrɑ kɑ ɡbɛ̃ɛrun biru dɛɛrɑsie ɑdɑmɑ bɛɛn sɔɔwɔ i tɑki kɑ nuku kɔ̃suru yibɑ.
Gɑri bɑkɑsu bɛɛ! Wi u wɑsin tɔɔ kuɑ, n ǹ wiyɑ u mɑɑ yin sɔɔ kuɑ?
I sɑ̃ɑrobu wɛ̃ɛyɔ ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ ɡbɛ̃ɛrun sɔɔwɔ, kpɑ ye yɑ tie yu bɛɛ dɛɛrɑ.

Bɛɛ Fɑlisibɑ, i ko nɔni swɑ̃ɑru wɑ yèn sɔ̃ i rɑ bɛɛn kɑrɑn kpee yi bɑ rɑ soku mɑntu kɑ duu, yin wɔkuru bɑɑteren wɔllɔ tiɑ wɛ̃. Kɑ mɛ, i rɑ ɡeɑn kobu nɔni sɑrɑri, i ǹ mɑɑ Gusunɔ kĩru sɔ̃ɔsimɔ. Yeniwɑ n weenɛ i ko, kpɑ i ku ye yɑ tie deri.
Bɛɛ Fɑlisibɑ, i ko nɔni swɑ̃ɑru wɑ yèn sɔ̃ i rɑ sin yee ɡbiikinu kɑ̃ mɛnnɔ yenɔ, kɑ tɔbirinɑɑ tɔn dɑbinun wuswɑɑɔ.
I ko nɔni swɑ̃ɑru wɑ, bɛɛ, yèn sɔ̃ i kɑ sikinu weenɛ ni ɡoo kun wɑɑmɔ, nìn wɔllɔ bɑ rɑ sĩ bɑ kun kɑ bɑɑru.
Woodɑ yɛ̃ro ɡoo u nɛɛ, yinni ɑ̀ n ɡerumɔ mɛ, kɑ mɑɑ bɛsɛrɑ ɑ wɔmmɔ.
Mɑ Yesu u nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, bɛɛ mɑɑ woodɑ yɛ̃robu i ko nɔni swɑ̃ɑru wɑ, domi i tɔmbu sɔmunu sɔbimɔ ni nu suɑbu sɛ̃, mɑ bɛɛn tii i ku rɑ ni ture bɑɑ kɑ bɛɛn niki biɑ.
I ko nɔni swɑ̃ɑru wɑ bɛɛ, yèn sɔ̃ i Gusunɔn sɔmɔbun sikɑ bɑnimɔ, be bɛɛn bɑɑbɑbɑ bɑ ɡo.
Nɡe mɛyɑ i sɔ̃ɔsimɔ ye bɑ kuɑ, i ǹ mɑɑ bu tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃. Domi beyɑ bɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔbu ɡo, mɑ bɛɛ i ben sikɑ bɑnimɔ.
Yeyɑ Gusunɔ u yɛ̃ u kɑ nɛɛ, wi, u koo bu Gusunɔn sɔmɔbu kɑ ɡɔrobu ɡɔriɑ. Bɑ koo ɡɑbu ɡo, bɑ koo mɑɑ ɡɑbu nɔni sɔ̃,
kpɑ bu tɛ̃n tɔmbu Gusunɔn sɔmɔ be kpuron yɛm bikiɑ mɛ mu yɑri hɑnduniɑn toren di,
sɑɑ Abɛlin yɛm di sere kɑ Sɑkɑrin yɛm wi bɑ ɡo yɑ̃ku yeru kɑ sɑ̃ɑ yerun bɑɑ sɔɔ. Kɑ ɡeemɑ nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, bɑ koo mu tɛ̃n tɔmbu bikiɑ.
I ko nɔni swɑ̃ɑru wɑ, bɛɛ woodɑ yɛ̃robu, yèn sɔ̃ i yɛ̃run ɡɑmbo kɛnuɑ. Bɛɛn tii i ǹ due, i mɑɑ yinɑ ɡɑbu bu du be bɑ kĩ.
Ye u yɑrɑ min di, woodɑ yɛ̃robu kɑ Fɑlisibɑ bɑ nùn ɡɑri dɑbinu bikikiɑ kɑ yibɛrɛ tɛɛru.
Bɑ nùn yɛ̃ri bɛriɑmmɛ ɡɑri sɔɔ, kpɑ ɡɛɛ yi kɑ nùn sɑmbɑ ko.
